verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an online IP filing and records service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a user-facing export of one's own filings or account data in open formats. The data.inpi.fr probe concerns token-gated access to the public open-data portal, not exporting personal account data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
